explanation: Bounds the scaled allocation extent in the common resource envelope. The relative scaled extent is dominated before it is added to absolute starting addresses in the allocation argument.
theorem_title: The scaled allocation extent fits its polynomial part
theorem_formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.scaled_extent_le (n : ℕ) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.scaledExtent n ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.polynomialPart n := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
At every natural input size $n$, $$\operatorname{scaledExtent}(n)\le\operatorname{polynomialPart}(n).$$ Both functions are the explicit shared reporting-bank resource expressions.

Bounds the scaled allocation extent in the common resource envelope. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
